audit_status.source_base: Greek Revelation text tradition; draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for messages to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira; symbolic assembly exhortation with anti-targeting safeguards.

verses.restored: To the messenger of the assembly in Ephesus write: These things says the One holding the seven stars in his right hand, walking among the seven golden lampstands.

familiar.text: Unto the angel of the church of Ephesus write; These things saith he that holdeth the seven stars in his right hand, who walketh in the midst of the seven golden candlesticks;

modern.text: “To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: These are the words of Him who holds the seven stars in His right hand and walks among the seven golden lampstands.

original.text: Τῷ ἀγγέλῳ ⸀τῆς ἐν Ἐφέσῳ ἐκκλησίας γράψον· Τάδε λέγει ὁ κρατῶν τοὺς ἑπτὰ ἀστέρας ἐν τῇ δεξιᾷ αὐτοῦ, ὁ περιπατῶν ἐν μέσῳ τῶν ἑπτὰ λυχνιῶν τῶν χρυσῶν·

verses.restored: I know your works, toil, endurance, and that you cannot bear harmful ones; you tested those calling themselves apostles and found them false.

familiar.text: I know thy works, and thy labour, and thy patience, and how thou canst not bear them which are evil: and thou hast tried them which say they are apostles, and are not, and hast found them liars:

modern.text: I know your deeds, your labor, and your perseverance. I know that you cannot tolerate those who are evil, and you have tested and exposed as liars those who falsely claim to be apostles.

original.text: Οἶδα τὰ ἔργα σου, καὶ τὸν ⸀κόπον καὶ τὴν ὑπομονήν σου, καὶ ὅτι οὐ δύνῃ βαστάσαι κακούς, καὶ ἐπείρασας τοὺς λέγοντας ἑαυτοὺς ⸀ἀποστόλους, καὶ οὐκ εἰσίν, καὶ εὗρες αὐτοὺς ψευδεῖς·

verses.restored: You have endurance and bore because of my name and have not grown weary.

familiar.text: And hast borne, and hast patience, and for my name’s sake hast laboured, and hast not fainted.

modern.text: Without growing weary, you have persevered and endured many things for the sake of My name.

original.text: καὶ ὑπομονὴν ἔχεις, καὶ ἐβάστασας διὰ τὸ ὄνομά μου, καὶ ⸂οὐ κεκοπίακες⸃.

verses.restored: But I have this against you: you left your first love.

familiar.text: Nevertheless I have somewhat against thee, because thou hast left thy first love.

modern.text: But I have this against you: You have abandoned your first love.

original.text: ἀλλὰ ἔχω κατὰ σοῦ ὅτι τὴν ἀγάπην σου τὴν πρώτην ἀφῆκες.

verses.restored: Remember from where you have fallen, turn/realign, and do the first works; otherwise I come and move your lampstand from its place, unless you turn.

familiar.text: Remember therefore from whence thou art fallen, and repent, and do the first works; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will remove thy candlestick out of his place, except thou repent.

modern.text: Therefore, keep in mind how far you have fallen. Repent and perform the deeds you did at first. But if you do not repent, I will come to you and remove your lampstand from its place.

original.text: μνημόνευε οὖν πόθεν ⸀πέπτωκας, καὶ μετανόησον καὶ τὰ πρῶτα ἔργα ποίησον· εἰ δὲ μή, ἔρχομαί ⸀σοι, καὶ κινήσω τὴν λυχνίαν σου ἐκ τοῦ τόπου αὐτῆς, ἐὰν μὴ μετανοήσῃς.

verses.restored: But this you have: you hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.

familiar.text: But this thou hast, that thou hatest the deeds of the Nicolaitanes, which I also hate.

modern.text: But you have this to your credit: You hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.

original.text: ἀλλὰ τοῦτο ἔχεις ὅτι μισεῖς τὰ ἔργα τῶν Νικολαϊτῶν, ἃ κἀγὼ μισῶ.

verses.restored: The one having ear, hear what Spirit says to the assemblies. To the one conquering I will give to eat from tree of life in the paradise of the Divine.

familiar.text: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of God.

modern.text: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will grant the right to eat from the tree of life in the Paradise of God. To the Church in Smyrna

original.text: ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις. τῷ νικῶντι δώσω αὐτῷ φαγεῖν ἐκ τοῦ ξύλου τῆς ζωῆς, ὅ ἐστιν ἐν τῷ παραδείσῳ τοῦ ⸀θεοῦ.

verses.restored: To the messenger of the assembly in Smyrna write: These things says the First and Last, who became dead and lived.

familiar.text: And unto the angel of the church in Smyrna write; These things saith the first and the last, which was dead, and is alive;

modern.text: To the angel of the church in Smyrna write: These are the words of the First and the Last, who died and returned to life.

original.text: Καὶ τῷ ἀγγέλῳ ⸀τῆς ἐν Σμύρνῃ ἐκκλησίας γράψον· Τάδε λέγει ὁ πρῶτος καὶ ὁ ἔσχατος, ὃς ἐγένετο νεκρὸς καὶ ἔζησεν·

verses.restored: I know your pressure and poverty, yet you are rich, and the slander from those saying they are Judeans and are not, but are assembly of the adversarial one.

familiar.text: I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich) and I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.

modern.text: I know your affliction and your poverty—though you are rich! And I am aware of the slander of those who falsely claim to be Jews, but are in fact a synagogue of Satan.

original.text: Οἶδά ⸀σου τὴν θλῖψιν καὶ τὴν πτωχείαν, ἀλλὰ πλούσιος εἶ, καὶ τὴν βλασφημίαν ἐκ τῶν λεγόντων Ἰουδαίους εἶναι ἑαυτούς, καὶ οὐκ εἰσίν, ἀλλὰ συναγωγὴ τοῦ Σατανᾶ.

verses.restored: Do not fear what you are about to suffer. Look, the accuser is about to cast some of you into prison so that you may be tested, and you will have pressure ten days. Become trustworthy until death, and I will give you crown of life.

familiar.text: Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer: behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days: be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life.

modern.text: Do not fear what you are about to suffer. Look, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison to test you, and you will suffer tribulation for ten days. Be faithful even unto death, and I will give you the crown of life.

original.text: ⸀μηδὲν φοβοῦ ἃ μέλλεις ⸀πάσχειν. ⸀ἰδοὺ μέλλει ⸀βάλλειν ὁ διάβολος ἐξ ὑμῶν εἰς φυλακὴν ἵνα πειρασθῆτε, καὶ ⸀ἕξετε θλῖψιν ἡμερῶν δέκα. γίνου πιστὸς ἄχρι θανάτου, καὶ δώσω σοι τὸν στέφανον τῆς ζωῆς.

verses.restored: The one having ear, hear what Spirit says to the assemblies. The one conquering will not be harmed by the second death.

familiar.text: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; He that overcometh shall not be hurt of the second death.

modern.text: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. The one who overcomes will not be harmed by the second death. To the Church in Pergamum

original.text: ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις. ὁ νικῶν οὐ μὴ ἀδικηθῇ ἐκ τοῦ θανάτου τοῦ δευτέρου.

verses.restored: To the messenger of the assembly in Pergamum write: These things says the One having the sharp two-edged sword.

familiar.text: And to the angel of the church in Pergamos write; These things saith he which hath the sharp sword with two edges;

modern.text: To the angel of the church in Pergamum write: These are the words of the One who holds the sharp, double-edged sword.

original.text: Καὶ τῷ ἀγγέλῳ τῆς ἐν Περγάμῳ ἐκκλησίας γράψον· Τάδε λέγει ὁ ἔχων τὴν ῥομφαίαν τὴν δίστομον τὴν ὀξεῖαν·

verses.restored: I know where you dwell, where the throne of the adversarial one is; and you hold fast my name and did not deny my trust even in days of Antipas, my trustworthy witness, who was killed among you where the adversarial one dwells.

familiar.text: I know thy works, and where thou dwellest, even where Satan’s seat is: and thou holdest fast my name, and hast not denied my faith, even in those days wherein Antipas was my faithful martyr, who was slain among you, where Satan dwelleth.

modern.text: I know where you live, where the throne of Satan sits. Yet you have held fast to My name and have not denied your faith in Me, even in the day when My faithful witness Antipas was killed among you, where Satan dwells.

original.text: ⸀Οἶδα ποῦ κατοικεῖς, ὅπου ὁ θρόνος τοῦ Σατανᾶ, καὶ κρατεῖς τὸ ὄνομά μου, καὶ οὐκ ἠρνήσω τὴν πίστιν μου ⸀καὶ ἐν ταῖς ⸀ἡμέραις Ἀντιπᾶς, ὁ μάρτυς μου, ὁ πιστός ⸀μου, ὃς ἀπεκτάνθη παρʼ ὑμῖν, ὅπου ὁ Σατανᾶς κατοικεῖ.

verses.restored: But I have a few things against you: you have some holding teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to put stumbling before sons of Israel, to eat idol-offerings and practice sexual misuse.

familiar.text: But I have a few things against thee, because thou hast there them that hold the doctrine of Balaam, who taught Balac to cast a stumblingblock before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed unto idols, and to commit fornication.

modern.text: But I have a few things against you, because some of you hold to the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to place a stumbling block before the Israelites so they would eat food sacrificed to idols and commit sexual immorality.

original.text: ἀλλὰ ἔχω κατὰ σοῦ ὀλίγα, ὅτι ἔχεις ἐκεῖ κρατοῦντας τὴν διδαχὴν Βαλαάμ, ὃς ⸂ἐδίδασκεν τῷ⸃ Βαλὰκ βαλεῖν σκάνδαλον ἐνώπιον τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ, ⸀φαγεῖν εἰδωλόθυτα καὶ πορνεῦσαι·

verses.restored: So also you have some holding teaching of Nicolaitans likewise.

familiar.text: So hast thou also them that hold the doctrine of the Nicolaitanes, which thing I hate.

modern.text: In the same way, some of you also hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.

original.text: οὕτως ἔχεις καὶ σὺ κρατοῦντας τὴν ⸀διδαχὴν Νικολαϊτῶν ὁμοίως.

verses.restored: Therefore turn/realign; otherwise I come to you quickly and will contend with them by the sword of my mouth.

familiar.text: Repent; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.

modern.text: Therefore repent! Otherwise I will come to you shortly and wage war against them with the sword of My mouth.

original.text: μετανόησον οὖν· εἰ δὲ μή, ἔρχομαί σοι ταχύ, καὶ πολεμήσω μετʼ αὐτῶν ἐν τῇ ῥομφαίᾳ τοῦ στόματός μου.

verses.restored: The one having ear, hear what Spirit says to assemblies. To the one conquering I will give hidden manna, and a white stone, and upon the stone a new name written that no one knows except the one receiving.

familiar.text: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the hidden manna, and will give him a white stone, and in the stone a new name written, which no man knoweth saving he that receiveth it.

modern.text: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will give the hidden manna. I will also give him a white stone inscribed with a new name, known only to the one who receives it. To the Church in Thyatira (Acts 16:11–15)

original.text: ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις. τῷ νικῶντι δώσω ⸀αὐτῷ τοῦ μάννα τοῦ κεκρυμμένου, καὶ δώσω αὐτῷ ψῆφον λευκήν, καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν ψῆφον ὄνομα καινὸν γεγραμμένον ὃ οὐδεὶς οἶδεν εἰ μὴ ὁ λαμβάνων.

verses.restored: To the messenger of the assembly in Thyatira write: These things says the Son of the Divine, having eyes like flame of fire and feet like burnished bronze.

familiar.text: And unto the angel of the church in Thyatira write; These things saith the Son of God, who hath his eyes like unto a flame of fire, and his feet are like fine brass;

modern.text: To the angel of the church in Thyatira write: These are the words of the Son of God, whose eyes are like a blazing fire and whose feet are like polished bronze.

original.text: Καὶ τῷ ἀγγέλῳ ⸀τῆς ἐν Θυατείροις ἐκκλησίας γράψον· Τάδε λέγει ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ, ὁ ἔχων τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ ὡς φλόγα πυρός, καὶ οἱ πόδες αὐτοῦ ὅμοιοι χαλκολιβάνῳ·

verses.restored: I know your works, love, trust, service, endurance, and that your latter works are greater than the first.

familiar.text: I know thy works, and charity, and service, and faith, and thy patience, and thy works; and the last to be more than the first.

modern.text: I know your deeds—your love, your faith, your service, your perseverance—and your latter deeds are greater than your first.

original.text: Οἶδά σου τὰ ἔργα, καὶ τὴν ⸂ἀγάπην καὶ τὴν πίστιν⸃ καὶ τὴν διακονίαν καὶ τὴν ὑπομονήν σου, καὶ τὰ ἔργα σου τὰ ἔσχατα πλείονα τῶν πρώτων.

verses.restored: But I have against you that you tolerate the woman Jezebel, the one calling herself prophet and teaching and misleading my servants into sexual misuse and eating idol-offerings.

familiar.text: Notwithstanding I have a few things against thee, because thou sufferest that woman Jezebel, which calleth herself a prophetess, to teach and to seduce my servants to commit fornication, and to eat things sacrificed unto idols.

modern.text: But I have this against you: You tolerate that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess. By her teaching she misleads My servants to be sexually immoral and to eat food sacrificed to idols.

original.text: ἀλλὰ ἔχω κατὰ σοῦ ὅτι ἀφεῖς τὴν ⸀γυναῖκα Ἰεζάβελ, ἡ ⸀λέγουσα ἑαυτὴν προφῆτιν, καὶ διδάσκει καὶ πλανᾷ τοὺς ἐμοὺς δούλους πορνεῦσαι καὶ φαγεῖν εἰδωλόθυτα.

verses.restored: I gave her time to turn, and she does not will to turn from her misuse.

familiar.text: And I gave her space to repent of her fornication; and she repented not.

modern.text: Even though I have given her time to repent of her immorality, she is unwilling.

original.text: καὶ ἔδωκα αὐτῇ χρόνον ἵνα μετανοήσῃ, καὶ οὐ θέλει μετανοῆσαι ἐκ τῆς πορνείας αὐτῆς.

verses.restored: Look, I cast her upon a bed, and those committing adultery with her into great pressure, unless they turn from her works.

familiar.text: Behold, I will cast her into a bed, and them that commit adultery with her into great tribulation, except they repent of their deeds.

modern.text: Behold, I will cast her onto a bed of sickness, and those who commit adultery with her will suffer great tribulation unless they repent of her deeds.

original.text: ἰδοὺ βάλλω αὐτὴν εἰς κλίνην, καὶ τοὺς μοιχεύοντας μετʼ αὐτῆς εἰς θλῖψιν μεγάλην, ἐὰν μὴ ⸀μετανοήσωσιν ἐκ τῶν ἔργων αὐτῆς·

verses.restored: And her children I will strike with death, and all assemblies will know that I am the One searching kidneys and hearts, and I will give to each according to your works.

familiar.text: And I will kill her children with death; and all the churches shall know that I am he which searcheth the reins and hearts: and I will give unto every one of you according to your works.

modern.text: Then I will strike her children dead, and all the churches will know that I am the One who searches minds and hearts, and I will repay each of you according to your deeds.

original.text: καὶ τὰ τέκνα αὐτῆς ἀποκτενῶ ἐν θανάτῳ· καὶ γνώσονται πᾶσαι αἱ ἐκκλησίαι ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ἐραυνῶν νεφροὺς καὶ καρδίας, καὶ δώσω ὑμῖν ἑκάστῳ κατὰ τὰ ἔργα ὑμῶν.

verses.restored: But to the rest in Thyatira, as many as do not hold this teaching, who did not know the so-called deep things of the adversarial one, I say: I do not cast upon you another weight.

familiar.text: But unto you I say, and unto the rest in Thyatira, as many as have not this doctrine, and which have not known the depths of Satan, as they speak; I will put upon you none other burden.

modern.text: But I say to the rest of you in Thyatira, who do not hold to her teaching and have not learned the so-called deep things of Satan: I will place no further burden upon you.

original.text: ὑμῖν δὲ λέγω τοῖς λοιποῖς τοῖς ἐν Θυατείροις, ὅσοι οὐκ ἔχουσιν τὴν διδαχὴν ταύτην, οἵτινες οὐκ ἔγνωσαν τὰ βαθέα τοῦ Σατανᾶ, ὡς λέγουσιν, οὐ βάλλω ἐφʼ ὑμᾶς ἄλλο βάρος·

verses.restored: Only hold fast what you have until I come.

familiar.text: But that which ye have already hold fast till I come.

modern.text: Nevertheless, hold fast to what you have until I come.

original.text: πλὴν ὃ ἔχετε κρατήσατε ἄχρι οὗ ἂν ἥξω.

verses.restored: To the one conquering and keeping my works until completion, I will give authority over the nations,

familiar.text: And he that overcometh, and keepeth my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations:

modern.text: And to the one who overcomes and continues in My work until the end, I will give authority over the nations.

original.text: καὶ ὁ νικῶν καὶ ὁ τηρῶν ἄχρι τέλους τὰ ἔργα μου, δώσω αὐτῷ ἐξουσίαν ἐπὶ τῶν ἐθνῶν,

verses.restored: and one will shepherd them with iron rod, as vessels of pottery are shattered, as I also received from my Father.

familiar.text: And he shall rule them with a rod of iron; as the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers: even as I received of my Father.

modern.text: He will rule them with an iron scepter and shatter them like pottery —just as I have received authority from My Father.

original.text: καὶ ποιμανεῖ αὐτοὺς ἐν ῥάβδῳ σιδηρᾷ ὡς τὰ σκεύη τὰ κεραμικὰ ⸀συντρίβεται,

verses.restored: And I will give that one the morning star.

familiar.text: And I will give him the morning star.

modern.text: And I will give him the morning star.

original.text: ὡς κἀγὼ εἴληφα παρὰ τοῦ πατρός μου, καὶ δώσω αὐτῷ τὸν ἀστέρα τὸν πρωϊνόν.

verses.restored: The one having ear, hear what Spirit says to the assemblies.

familiar.text: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.

modern.text: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.

original.text: ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις.

translation_notes: Assembly messages are symbolic pastoral diagnoses, not permission to target modern groups.
'Judeans and are not' language in Smyrna is local conflict rhetoric and must never become anti-Jewish contempt.
Sword from mouth is word/judgment imagery.
safety_note: Revelation 2 uses severe symbolic warning. Do not literalize violence or weaponize labels such as Jezebel, Balaam, or adversarial assembly against people.
